title: Data
description: pixelbar/<target>/data/<key>, retained. One value for the pool, shaped like a Home Assistant state. An empty payload removes it.

value.description: A number, words, true or false, a list, or null when unknown.

unit.description: The unit shown after the value, like °C or kWh.

attributes.description: Anything else a card can read, like humidity, high and low, or a history list.

stale_after.description: After this long without an update, cards reading it dim and show a mark.
